title: ProjectE series-shunt current measurement plan
description: Output of tools/scripts/shunt_plan.py. Plans series shunts and probe testpoints so a per-rail current can be measured on the bench without cutting a trace or lifting a pin. It is a PLAN, never an edit: schematics here are generated from pin tables, so a modification made behind the generator's back is erased by the next build and leaves no trace of having been erased. 'mutates_schematic' is pinned false to keep that property visible to anything that consumes this artifact.

phase.description: No board exists yet, so no testpoint here carries a pad coordinate or a probe-accessibility claim. The layout constraints attached to each injection are requirements ON a later phase, not results from one.

resolution_uv.description: The smallest step the instrument DISPLAYS. This is not its accuracy, and the two are routinely confused: a meter showing 10 uV steps may be specified to 0.5% of reading. The plan uses this for the resolution bound only.

max_uncertainty_pct.description: The accuracy budget. When null, the achievable uncertainty is still computed and reported, but the 'uncertainty_within_budget' finding is NO_COVERAGE: a figure nobody declared a limit for has not been judged, and reporting PASS because the arithmetic succeeded is the exact failure this tool exists to prevent.

downstream_override.description: A shunt between the bypass bank and the load carries the load's transient current, degrading the rail under di/dt and making the reading noisy. Overriding requires a stated reason so the decision is legible later.

full_scale_current_a.description: The regulator's RATED output, from its datasheet - deliberately not the expected draw. Sizing the instrument from the quantity it is meant to measure would be circular, and this tool exists precisely where that quantity is unknown.

r_min_ohm.description: From the resolution requirement: meter_resolution / current_resolution.

r_max_ohm.description: From the droop budget: max_droop / full_scale_current. A fixed-output regulator senses at its own pin, upstream of the shunt, so this drop is not corrected.

window.description: The two bounds pull in opposite directions. When they cross, the window is empty and no value is emitted - 'the measurement cannot be made this way with this meter' is the answer, not the nearest value.

package_power_w.description: Never defaulted. Ratings for one nominal package span more than 3x across vendors, so an assumed rating is an invented one.

parasitic_ohm.description: Pad and trace resistance in series with the element. Without Kelvin sensing this term does not cancel, and a few milliohms of copper is a double-digit percentage of a 10 milliohm shunt.

current_uncertainty_pct.description: null when the terms required to compute it were not supplied. An unknown uncertainty is never reported as a small one.

injections.description: What a schematic generator has to emit. Consumed by the board's own generator; this tool does not perform it.

testpoints.description: Named by which side of the shunt they touch. A differential reading whose polarity is ambiguous gets logged with the wrong sign.

net_split.description: Inserting a series element splits the rail into two nets. Every node except the regulator pin moves to the load side; anything that named the old net - a netclass rule, an interface contract - has to be told, because two different nets would otherwise answer to one name.
